# GrowthBook Training: Positioning & Walkthrough
Date: 2026-08-26 | Duration: 62.47999954223633m

## Summary
The team agreed to reschedule their weekly catch-up to Friday afternoon to accommodate overlapping interviews, ensuring full participation. During the meeting, they discussed the recent affiliate webinar, which attracted 55 attendees primarily from newspaper companies like the New York Post and New York Times, emphasizing tailored messaging that aligns with sales targets. Graham McNicoll delivered training on GrowthBook's modular platform, highlighting its customizability and the unique feature flagging capabilities. Detailed discussion included transparent experiment analysis metrics that aid decision-making. The integration of AI to summarize experiments and track program health was also covered, along with plans for benchmarking customer performance against industry standards.

## Keywords
GrowthBook, feature flags, experimentation platform, customizable roles, AI analysis, experiment results
